items.title: Israel Gorman Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: His clarinet was on the order of, like, say, it was very little different between him and Benny Goodman. And you know Benny Goodman is a clarinet man.

ctx.x: Well, I was going to ask a little bit more about T.O., what style, since he isn't living, I never got to hear him except the records he made with Pirone, but how did he play? What was his tone like and what style did he have? Can you tell us something?

Well, Pirone, not Pirone, T.O., T.O., he fella had a really very nice tone. He had a really clarinet tone. His clarinet was on the order of, like, say, it was very little different between him and Benny Goodman. And you know Benny Goodman is a clarinet man.
Did he have an extra loud tone or a clearer tone? What did you say?
